description: 交通量調査(佐世保市) [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 佐世保市. Coverage: 佐世保市. The portal files it under the publisher 佐世保市. Its tags are 統計. It offers 16 resource(s) in pdf, xls. The portal shows 2019-10-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
